rv.q: The brilliant Matthew Masino (Director) breathes new life into this classic work that Edward Albee once wrote is ‘the best American play ever written.’
Lazy Susan Theatre is staging a warm and naturalistic production laden with the sweetness and sorrows of daily life.
It turned out to be a quiet, gentle show that sneaks up on you in the final act.

With a welcoming preshow, an engaging ensemble, and an intimate staging that makes the audience feel a part of the community, Lazy Susan Co.'s Our Town is a heartfelt celebration of life's everyday moments.

cn.t: Lazy Susan Theatre's *Our Town* earns warm praise for its intimate staging and heartfelt ensemble work. Critics call it a moving celebration of everyday life, with scores ranging from 75–93.
